olivia.h: Quick heads-up — external pen-test vendor (RedProbe) kickoff is next Thu 11:00 PT. We need a final slice of scope: KMS read-only proxy, ephemeral RBAC for assessors, and audit log retention windows.

rahul.k: Thanks. Can we lock down the RBAC change window to a 2‑hour slot? Prefer 09:00–11:00 PT so ops has morning overlap. Also need to confirm who can elevate during the window.

sam.t: +1 to the 2‑hour slot. Suggest we use the ephemeral role pipeline: assessor-role-prod-readonly + temp-signer for evidence exports. Jin — can you confirm the automation works for presigned evidence URLs?

jin.w: I tested the presigned flow yesterday. It creates a read-only S3 presign via keystore-proxy and signs with a KMS key in the staging replica. Production will need the KMS grant.

olivia.h: Important: external testers will request some console snapshots. We should avoid handing out long-lived console perms. Use role chaining only. Also need to ensure audit logs surface via /audit-stream to the central SIEM within 5m.

ops-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Ephemeral role bake job scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-20260330T08:00Z -> expires 20260330T12:00Z.

rahul.k: On KMS: ops, can you confirm we have an audit-only KMS grant that logs Decrypt/Sign attempts to CloudTrail and forwards key usage to the audit index? We want to avoid giving testers Decrypt capability.

sam.t: We should give them only GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for artifact signing, not Decrypt. Also add an allow-list for the presign lambda.

jin.w: Action item: I'll open a short runbook that shows the exact IAM/KMS policy snippet. We'll include a sample presign command and the audit query to validate accesses. Here's a quick snippet: 
```
# presign lambda role policy (excerpt)
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext", "s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EXAMPLE"]
}
```

olivia.h: Nice. For remediation tracking: we want pen-test findings to hit the vuln-triage board (project: pen-2026-q2). Each finding needs a severity, repro steps, owner, and expected retest window. Can we auto-create tickets from the intake form?

rahul.k: Yes — the intake webhook can create GH issues with labels. Add an additional label `requires-kms-review` if the finding touches key material or presigned flows. Also tag `rbac` when role changes are implicated.

sam.t: For retest coordination: plan to block a 4‑hour retest window one week after initial fixes. Ops should reserve an environment snapshot and a shortlived key for verification. We need snapshots kept for 72h post-retest.

jin.w: I'll add a step in the runbook to snapshot the keystore state (`keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN_ID`) and export CloudTrail query hashes. We'll also include a command to validate no unintended Decrypt calls: 
```
# validate no Decrypt calls from assessor id
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-redprobe | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'
```

olivia.h: One more: incident response alignment. If pen-test uncovers an active exploit, we treat as IR outside the retest flow — escalate to oncall-SOC and tag incident channel #incidents. Add a contact card for the SOC lead in the runbook.

rahul.k: I'll own the escalation mapping. I'll also make a short checklist for the engineers doing hotfixes: roll-forward vs rollback acceptance criteria, and evidence collection steps.

sam.t: Can someone create the intake Google Form + webhook by EOD tomorrow? We need it live before vendor kickoff.

jin.w: I'll spin up the form and the webhook. Posting runbook link here when ready.

olivia.h: Great — thanks everyone. Final action items: Jin (runbook + form + presign policy), Rahul (escalation mapping + ticket labels), Sam (reserve retest window + env snapshot policy). I'll publish the scope doc and invite vendor after we confirm the ephemeral role bake.

ops-bot: [reminder] Meeting scheduled: PenTest Kickoff — 2026-03-30 11:00 PT. Attendees: olivia.h, rahul.k, sam.t, jin.w, vendor-redprobe.

olivia.h: 👍  Closing thread; will follow up with runbook link.
